headline: 2 dead, including a child, in gas leak explosion in Bhatara
summary: A devastating explosion caused by a gas leak has claimed two lives in the Bhatara area.
details: A gas leak led to a powerful explosion in the Bhatara area, resulting in the deaths of two people, including a child.
The incident caused immediate panic in the neighborhood as the blast ripped through the affected structure.
Emergency services responded to the scene to manage the aftermath and recover the victims.
Authorities are investigating the exact cause of the leak to determine if it was due to technical failure or negligence.
